title: [sonic-mgmt snmp] Multi-asic support added test_snmp_queue.py does not work for multiple linecards
author: veronica-arista
body:
**Description**

The multi-asic support for test_snmp_queue.py added in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/9115/ does not work on DUTs with two different linecards.

The test fetches all the QUEUE KEYS from CONFIG_DB, which correspond to interfaces on all the linecards.  If the DUT has two different linecards with different interface aliases, the test will incorrectly expect all these interfaces on each linecard.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Run test_snmp_queue.py on a DUT with two different linecards (which have different interface aliases)
2.
3.

**Describe the results you received:**
Test fails with error like:
```
E           AssertionError: Port Ethernet216 with QUEUE config is not present in snmp interfaces
```

**Describe the results you expected:**
test should pass
